Subject: Mutual action plan + Week0 workshop — request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Novara is excited about the performance profile you showed. Procurement and engineering asked if you could share a concise mutual action artifact we can work from (roles, week0 agenda, tech checkpoints, procurement milestones).

High level asks:
- A one‑page workbook we can co‑edit that captures acceptance criteria and dependencies.
- A compact Week0 deck for the kickoff workshop (60 minutes) with a clear owner list.
- Any prework Novara needs to do for security or SSO validation.

Can you share whatever you typically use? We’d like to lock a tentative kickoff for the week of June 23.

Best,
Claire Ramos
Director, Clinical Integrations
Novara Health

Hi Claire — great to hear, and glad the demo resonated.

I attached an editable MAP_Workbook_v0.1 (Google Doc) and a compact Week0 slide deck. The workbook is intentionally lightweight — sectioned by: Goals, Acceptance Tests, Technical Prereqs, Stakeholders & Owners, Risk & Mitigations, and Timeline/Gates.

Quick asks on our side:
- Can Novara confirm an SSO contact (name + email) before Week0 so we can precheck the SAML metadata?
- Who owns data retention decisions on your side (security/compliance lead)?

Jonas & Marissa — looping you in for quick comments on the acceptance tests and timeline. I tried to keep the first draft short so Novara can iterate directly in the doc.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Jun 24, 10:30–11:30 PT (we can shift). If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief prework checklist.

Attachments: MAP_Workbook_v0.1.gdoc (editable), Week0_Workshop_Slides.pptx (slide pack)

Cheers,
Grace O’Connor
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Grace — I skimmed the workbook and left inline comments in the doc. Two quick notes I want to call out here so Claire sees them:

1) Acceptance tests — suggest adding a short smoke test for token latency under a 128‑token prompt (we usually use the sample patient note). That helps the Novara infra team validate perf during Week0.
2) Tech prereqs — add 'SSH access to a sandbox instance' as optional prework if they want an early integration spike.

Also proposed a minor timeline tweak: move the first tech touch by 3 business days earlier (so infra has time to test before the nominal demo). I left a suggested date in the timeline table.

If no objections I’ll make the edits directly.

— Jonas
